title: Vanilla Board Games
description: Replaces Blocks with Parts for you to play Board Games
body:
This Texture Pack just adds some Board Games I thought would be Cool in Minecraft (Currently there is just Connect 4, but I am planning to add Guess Who and maybe others in the future)

Connect 4: To set up the board place 1 Scaffolding and stand on it then Right Click the top of it 6 times to make it 7 blocks long. Then Shift Right Click the top of it to place one on top, Right Click it 6 times to make it 7 blocks long (Repeat this step until the Scaffold is 6 blocks tall) Place Red and Yellow Concrete Powder infront of the top Scaffolding to Play. Once someone has Connected 4 Go to the back to see the Pieces with the Board infront of them. (If you make a version with Pistons activated from afar you can have Scaffolding on both sides to make it look better)
